**v0.1.6** · 521 changes from 137 contributors

## Highlights
Ask questions in side chats without derailing the main thread. Pin favorite projects and archive old ones. Review local commits in the Diff pane. Use 1Password for provider and source-control credentials.

## Fixes
- New threads show their first reply without reloading (#27522)
- Stop completes even when an agent is unresponsive (#27252)
- T3 Connect sockets no longer disconnect every hour (#27998)
- Deleting a thread no longer removes a shared worktree (#24489)
- Truncated Markdown previews no longer overwrite full files (#22339)
- Commits no longer land on a switched branch (#24473)
- Codex-generated images appear in chat (#19066)
- Claude MCP confirmation requests appear for approval (#21903)
- Okta sign-in works in desktop browser tabs (#22835)
- Connection tickets and OAuth credentials stay out of traces (#27986)
